infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Arrivo uses your location only while the app is open, so you can place alarms on the map. Location stays on this device and is not sent to external servers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Arrivo reads your location in the background only during trips with active alarms, so it can ring when you enter a saved place. There is no permanent tracking; coordinates stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Arrivo reads your location in the background only during trips with active alarms, so it can ring when you enter a saved place. There is no permanent tracking; coordinates stay on this device.
